title: The Silent Invitation
description: A qin melody drifts from Cloud-Reed Terrace. The notes speak of discipline, honor, and the weight of righteousness.

title: The First Lesson
description: Lan Wangji sits in perfect stillness. 'Discipline begins with breath. Righteousness begins with choice.'

title: Investigation of Truth
description: A corruption spreads through the sect. Lan Wangji watches as you choose between easy lies and difficult truths.
